title: Markets we serve: 14 frontier markets on 3 continents | Nazryx
description: Nazryx serves 14 pharmaceutical markets on 3 continents: Central Asia, East and West Africa, North Africa, the Middle East and South America.

sections.title: 14 markets
sections.lede: Asia, Africa and South America. Frontier markets with their own rules, buyers and clocks, read and run one at a time.

sections.title: Six regions.
sections.lede: Pick a region to see how we think about entering it.

sections.title: What we know
sections.lede: Our view of each market in two facts. Kazakhstan is shown in full; every other market file is available on request.

items.title: Africa is converging
items.text: The African Medicines Agency became operational in October 2025. East Africa already shares assessments across 7 regulators.

items.title: Eurasia is consolidating
items.text: National registrations not aligned to EAEU rules are being annulled in several member states. Kazakhstan's national route closes on 31 Dec 2027.

items.title: Central Asia is opening
items.text: Uzbekistan cut registration review times to 60–120 days in Nov 2025. Early filers get the head start.

sections.title: Ask for a market file.
sections.text: Tell us which market and send your product list. We will show you what is open there.
